on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  push:
    branches: [main]
  schedule:
    - cron: "17 3 * * 1"   # weekly re-scan: new CVEs appear in dependencies we did not change
  workflow_dispatch:       # "Run workflow" button on the Actions tab

# Least privilege: the token is read-only unless a job asks for more.
permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: security-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  # 1. Tests - every sec*/ folder's pytest suite (SEC-15 ... SEC-20)
  tests:
    name: Tests - pytest
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"
      - name: Run the tests of every module
        run: python sec20_ci_cd/run_all_tests.py

  # 2a. Static analysis (SAST) - Semgrep
  semgrep:
    name: SAST - Semgrep
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    container:
      image: semgrep/semgrep
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Semgrep - fails the build on any finding
        run: >
          semgrep scan
          --config p/python --config p/flask --config p/secrets
          --metrics=off --error --exclude tests .

  # 2b. Static analysis (SAST) - CodeQL (results appear in the Security tab)
  codeql:
    name: SAST - CodeQL
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    permissions:
      contents: read
      security-events: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: github/codeql-action/init@v3
        with:
          languages: python
          queries: security-extended
      - uses: github/codeql-action/analyze@v3

  # 3. Dependency scan - known vulnerabilities in any requirements.txt
  dependency-scan:
    name: Dependency scan - pip-audit
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"
      - run: pip install pip-audit
      - run: python sec20_ci_cd/collect_requirements.py all-requirements.txt
      - name: Fail on any known vulnerability
        run: pip-audit -r all-requirements.txt --strict --vulnerability-service osv

  # 4. Secret scan - gitleaks over the WHOLE git history
  secret-scan:
    name: Secret scan - gitleaks
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    env:
      GITLEAKS_VERSION: "8.21.2"
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0   # full history, so a secret that was "deleted" later is still caught
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Install gitleaks
        run: |
          curl -sSfL "https://github.com/gitleaks/gitleaks/releases/download/v${GITLEAKS_VERSION}/gitleaks_${GITLEAKS_VERSION}_linux_x64.tar.gz" \
            | tar -xz gitleaks
      - name: Scan every commit - fails if a secret is found
        run: ./gitleaks git --config .gitleaks.toml --redact --verbose --exit-code 1 .

  # 5. SBOM - a CycloneDX list of every package (and version) we ship
  sbom:
    name: SBOM - CycloneDX
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"
      - name: Install exactly what the modules need, in a clean virtualenv
        run: |
          python sec20_ci_cd/collect_requirements.py all-requirements.txt
          python -m venv /tmp/app-env
          /tmp/app-env/bin/pip install -r all-requirements.txt
          pip install cyclonedx-bom
      - name: Generate the SBOM
        run: cyclonedx-py environment /tmp/app-env --of JSON -o sbom.cdx.json
      - name: Check the SBOM is valid and not empty
        run: python sec20_ci_cd/check_sbom.py sbom.cdx.json
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: sbom-cyclonedx
          path: sbom.cdx.json
          retention-days: 90
